(2) BOUNDED RETRY + error_log/next_retry_at + DEAD-LETTER [DOC §12 L252, §19 L376]: PENDING/IN_FLIGHT/SENT/DEAD_LETTER lifecycle ([EXT]); on failure increment attempt_count, append error_log, set next_retry_at=now+backoff (exp backoff+jitter [EXT]); attempt_count>=max_attempts -> DEAD_LETTER with full trace, never deleted ('no silent loss'); max_attempts/backoff/failure-rate = M6-OD-002; exercised by proposed smoke M6-SMK-016. (4) WORKER ISOLATION [DOC L249]: two isolated dispatchers, no request-path coupling.
